scenes.title: ETH Big Blue Centrifuge Inspection Bay
scenes.institution: Geotechnical Centrifuge Center — Big Blue beam centrifuge
scenes.reference_notes: An installed blue beam spans a bright white enclosure. Two deep blue suspended end cradles, a central hub/service bay, yellow overhead panels and large floor grilles remain visible around a team standing in front. The photographed people provide an approximate scale but obscure some central mechanics.
observed_cues: Blue spanning beam with deep pivoted cradles at both ends
Yellow overhead shielding/service panels above a white enclosure
Segmented floor with large inset metal grilles

equipment.role: Position the beam through a small azimuth arc and tilt a retained inert model cradle without simulating centrifuge acceleration.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry from inspected official photo; dimensions and hidden mechanics estimated

support.evidence: The central drive column and grounded service cabinet support the beam and pinned hanging cradles.

scenes.title: EPFL TCV Diagnostic Access Sector
scenes.institution: Swiss Plasma Center — TCV diagnostic access sector
scenes.reference_notes: An installed close-up shows a tall structural bay with stacked bolted rectangular access panels on the right and multiple large wrapped cylindrical beam/diagnostic ports on the left. A small purple viewport, flexible metal hoses and supported cable routes establish the access-sector arrangement. The image does not establish the complete tokamak hall.
observed_cues: Stacked rectangular bolt-ring panels beside a white structural upright
Several large horizontal wrapped cylinders and flange collars
Dense fixed hoses/cables around a small circular viewport

equipment.role: Open an original dry inspection panel through a bounded arc and translate a visible inert exterior datum.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry from inspected official photo; dimensions and hidden mechanics estimated

support.evidence: Grounded vertical frames and exterior brackets carry the cylindrical ports and panel hinges.

scenes.title: TU Delft DUCAT Near-Field Chamber
scenes.institution: Microwave Sensing Signals and Systems — DUCAT antenna test chamber
scenes.reference_notes: Installed near-field and far-field photographs show blue pyramidal absorbers on walls/roof/floor, a tall cream scanner mast with cable chain and instrument shelf, wooden/foam antenna mounts and a clear narrow floor strip. The near-field photo includes a wood platform with a round patterned target and a vector-network instrument on the mast shelf.
observed_cues: Long narrow chamber lined by blue pyramids including the floor
Cream vertical scanner with black cable chain and projecting instrument shelf
Separated antenna stands with a narrow clear access strip

equipment.role: Translate the near-field inspection head in height and laterally across a fixed inert circular reference target.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry from inspected official photo; dimensions and hidden mechanics estimated

support.evidence: Scanner mast stands on its foot; network-instrument shelf is braced to the mast, and the target sits on the wooden platform.

scenes.title: TUM NMA Unpowered Motor Inspection Cell

scenes.reference_notes: The installed apparatus photograph in the official December 2024 specification sheet shows a silver dyno/load machine on the left, a circular coupling/test face with thick orange cables, rear tall pale electrical cabinets and a white/dark-blue electronics enclosure on an aluminium rack at right. A glazed wall corner and floor cables establish an actual test-cell setting.
observed_cues: Silver horizontal load machine and exposed circular coupling plane
Thick orange cables running from the test face down to floor services
Tall pale rear cabinets beside a white/dark-blue instrument enclosure on a rack

equipment.role: Translate a retained inspection carriage and index a visible inert coupon on an unpowered motor-test-face proxy.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry from inspected official photo; dimensions and hidden mechanics estimated

support.evidence: Load-machine plinth, carriage legs and aluminium electronics rack meet the floor; the inert coupon is mechanically retained.
